setup.welcome.title: Welcome to RealOpen-AI
setup.welcome.subtitle: Your fully offline, private AI assistant. This setup wizard will help you configure your hardware profile, choose which features to enable, and download the required AI models.
setup.welcome.offline: Everything runs locally on your machine — no data is sent to the cloud. All models are downloaded from Ollama and run entirely offline.
setup.prerequisites.title: Prerequisites Check
setup.prerequisites.subtitle: Let's make sure everything you need is ready.
setup.hardware.title: Hardware Detection
setup.hardware.subtitle: We detected the following hardware on your system.
setup.modules.title: Choose Modules
setup.modules.subtitle: Enable the features you want. Required modules are always active. Optional modules can be toggled later in Settings.
setup.review.title: Review Configuration
setup.review.subtitle: Confirm your setup before we download the models.
setup.installing.title: Downloading Models
setup.installing.subtitle: We're downloading the AI models needed for your configuration. This may take a while depending on your internet speed.
setup.done.title: Setup Complete!
setup.done.subtitle: Your RealOpen-AI is ready. All models have been downloaded and your configuration has been applied. You can start chatting now!

brain.skills.description: Learned skills from your conversations will appear here

brain.history.info: Search through all your past conversation messages by keyword. The AI can also search these automatically when you ask about something discussed previously.
